title: XpSearchContract
description: Wire contract for the Xperience Search HTTP API (spec 4.2, 4.3, 9.1). This schema is the single source of truth: the C# DTOs (XpSearch.Core.Contract) and the TypeScript types (@yourco/xperience-search) are generated from it and must never be hand-edited. Field names deliberately mirror Algolia's request/response shape. That is a documented feature, not an accident: a team moving off Algolia can swap the transport and keep most of their UI code. Endpoints: POST /api/xpsearch/query (SearchRequest -> SearchResponse), POST /api/xpsearch/suggest (SuggestRequest -> SuggestResponse), POST /api/xpsearch/events (EventRequest -> 202 Accepted with an empty body; there is no event response type). Every response carries the header X-XpSearch-Api-Version: 1; the contract version is the semver major of both the NuGet and npm packages, and routes never carry a version segment. Errors are RFC 9457 Problem Details (application/problem+json) as produced by ASP.NET Core's ProblemDetails - see https://learn.microsoft.com/aspnet/core/web-api/handle-errors - and are deliberately not redefined here.

searchRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SearchRequest. Never sent on the wire.

searchResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SearchResponse. Never sent on the wire.

suggestRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SuggestRequest. Never sent on the wire.

suggestResponse.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits SuggestResponse. Never sent on the wire.

eventRequest.description: Placeholder property so the code generator emits EventRequest. Never sent on the wire.

index.description: Required. Code name of the Lucene index to search, as registered in the Xperience Search application. Must be non-empty; validated server-side, which answers 400 Problem Details when it is not.

query.description: Free-text query. An empty string (the default) means match all documents.

hitsPerPage.description: Number of hits per page. Defaults to 20. The maximum of 1000 is a contract ceiling; the effective maximum is enforced server-side and may be lower per configuration.

facets.description: Attributes to compute facet counts for. Counts come back in SearchResponse.facets.

items.description: One OR group. Any matching value inside the group satisfies it.
A filter in "attribute:value" form, for example "contentType:Article".

facetFilters.description: Facet refinements. The outer array is ANDed, each inner array is ORed: [["contentType:Article","contentType:Product"],["tags:coffee"]] means (Article OR Product) AND coffee.

items.description: A numeric comparison, for example "price<=50" or "publishedAt>=1700000000".

numericFilters.description: Numeric refinements, ANDed together. Grammar: attribute, operator, number - where the attribute starts with a letter or underscore and may contain word characters and dots, the operator is one of <=, >=, <, >, =, != and the number is an optionally negative integer or decimal. Whitespace around the operator is allowed. Dates are compared as Unix epoch seconds.

sort.description: Sort order: the literal "relevance" (the default, score descending) or a sort key configured for the index.

highlight.description: Highlighting options. Omit to use the defaults.

items.description: Attribute name to include on each hit.

attributesToRetrieve.description: Attributes to project onto each hit. Omit to return the index's configured default projection. objectID is always returned.

language.description: Language code of the content to search, for example "en". Omit to use the current request's language.

queryId.description: Client-supplied correlation id echoed back on the response and used to tie click and conversion events to this search. Omit to have the server generate one.

explain.description: When true, each hit carries _rankingInfo explaining its score. Defaults to false. Used by the admin query tester (spec 8.4).

fields.description: Fields to produce highlighted snippets for. Results land in Hit._highlights.

preTag.description: Markup inserted before each match. Defaults to "<mark>".

postTag.description: Markup inserted after each match. Defaults to "</mark>".

snippetLength.description: Maximum snippet length in characters. Defaults to 200.

SearchResponse.title: SearchResponse
SearchResponse.description: Body of a 200 response from POST /api/xpsearch/query.

hits.description: The hits on the requested page, in ranked order.

facets.description: Facet counts, keyed by attribute name and then by facet value. Only attributes listed in SearchRequest.facets appear, and only values with a non-zero count in the current result set.

additionalProperties.description: Counts for one attribute, keyed by facet value.
Number of matching documents carrying this value.

page.description: Zero-based number of the page that was returned.

hitsPerPage.description: Page size that was applied, after server-side clamping.

nbHits.description: Total number of matching documents across all pages.

processingTimeMs.description: Server-side processing time in milliseconds, excluding network time.

queryId.description: Correlation id for this search. Echoes SearchRequest.queryId when supplied, otherwise server-generated. Send it back on click and conversion events.

Hit.title: Hit
Hit.description: One search result. Deliberately an open object: objectID and the underscore-prefixed members are reserved by the contract, and every other property is a retrieved document attribute (title, url, summary, image, ...) whose set is decided by SearchRequest.attributesToRetrieve and the index configuration.

objectID.description: Required. Stable unique identifier of the indexed document. Send it back on click and conversion events.

_score.description: Final relevance score after boosts and rules. Higher is more relevant; values are only comparable within one response.

_highlights.description: Highlighted snippets keyed by field name. Present only for fields requested in SearchRequest.highlight.fields. Values are HTML-encoded content with the configured pre and post tags inserted, so they are safe to render as HTML.

_rankingInfo.description: Score explanation. Present only when SearchRequest.explain is true; absent otherwise.

url.description: Canonical link to the document, when the index projects one. Always root-relative ("/articles/espresso-basics") or absolute ("https://example.com/articles/espresso-basics"); never the app-relative "~/..." form Xperience's URL retriever returns - the server resolves that before it reaches the wire.

RankingInfo.title: RankingInfo
RankingInfo.description: Per-hit score explanation, returned only when SearchRequest.explain is true (spec 4.2, 8.4).

baseScore.description: Lucene score before any boost rule was applied.

items.description: One applied boost or rule, formatted source:effect, for example "freshness:+1.2" or "rule:pin-espresso-guide".

appliedBoosts.description: Boosts and rules that changed the score or position, in application order.

position.description: One-based position of this hit in the final ranking, across all pages.

SuggestRequest.title: SuggestRequest
SuggestRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/suggest. Whether an index answers with query suggestions or with federated hits is server-side per-index configuration, not a request field.

index.description: Required. Code name of the Lucene index to suggest from. Must be non-empty; validated server-side, which answers 400 Problem Details when it is not.

query.description: Required. The partial input to prefix-match. May be an empty string, which yields no suggestions.

maxItems.description: Maximum number of suggestions to return. Defaults to 5. Enforced server-side.

language.description: Language code to suggest in, for example "en". Omit to use the current request's language.

SuggestResponse.title: SuggestResponse
SuggestResponse.description: Body of a 200 response from POST /api/xpsearch/suggest.

suggestions.description: Suggestions in display order, at most SuggestRequest.maxItems of them.

text.description: Required. The text to display and, for a query suggestion, to search for when picked.

hits.description: Documents behind this suggestion, present only for indexes configured in federated-hits mode.

url.description: Link to follow when the suggestion is picked, present only for indexes configured in federated-hits mode. Root-relative or absolute, never the app-relative "~/..." form.

EventRequest.title: EventRequest
EventRequest.description: Body of POST /api/xpsearch/events (spec 4.3, 9.1). The endpoint answers 202 Accepted with an empty body, so there is no response type. Logging is consent-gated and best-effort: a 202 means the event was accepted, not that an activity was written.

eventType.description: Required. "click" when the user opens a result, "conversion" when the developer signals a goal reached after a search.

queryId.description: Required. The queryId from the SearchResponse that produced the hit. This is what correlates the event back to its search.

objectID.description: Required. objectID of the hit the event is about.

position.description: One-based position of the hit in the result list. Required when eventType is "click", ignored for "conversion".

index.description: Code name of the index the search ran against. Omit to have the server resolve it from queryId.
